title: Harmonize multi‑cloud catalog assets and staged GTM rollout for marketplace syndication
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: produce a single canonical catalog payload and release-note artifact that can be transformed and published to AWS Marketplace (Seller Center), Azure Marketplace, and GCP Marketplace with a staged rollout plan across regions. The work covers SKU mapping, pricing tier alignment, marketing copy variants, icon/asset sizing, legal/terms review per cloud, telemetry/entitlement hooks, and the coordinated release notes choreography needed for simultaneous and staggered launches.

Scope:
- Create canonical catalog spec (JSON + human-readable) that distills required fields for each cloud and includes mapping rules for SKU/entitlement differences.
- Produce a harmonized release-notes bundle (versions, changelog, breaking notes, migration steps) and ensure it is consumable by the three marketplace publishing pipelines.
- Define staging gates: automated smoke tests (runtime sign-in, billing handshake, basic inference request), contract tests with marketplace billing APIs, and a manual legal sign-off step.
- Coordinate asset production (logos, screenshots, feature bullets) and size/format variants with Design.
- Plan the staged rollout (region-by-region) and rollback criteria for each provider.

Success metrics:
- All three marketplace listings publish with identical product payload intent (no feature drift) within the scheduled window.
- Zero critical regressions in customer onboarding flows during the first 72 hours after each cloud rollout.
- Release notes published and linked from console, docs site, and marketplace pages.

Stakeholders: PM (Ava), Product Ops (Riley), Design (Maya Patel), Legal (Jordan Kim), Engineering (runtime + infra leads), DevRel, Support, Sales Engineering.

Risks and mitigations:
- Divergent publishing requirements per cloud (mitigate: canonical spec + small per-cloud transform adapters owned by Eng).
- Legal term timing delays (mitigate: early draft and parallel review, reserve short-stop date in rollout).
- Asset rejections due to size/metadata (mitigate: pre-validate assets against each marketplace validation tool and include fallback images).
acceptance_criteria: Canonical catalog JSON schema checked in to confluence + GH gist and validated with sample transforms for AWS/Azure/GCP
Release-notes bundle (md + structured JSON) produced and linked in product changelog; marketing copy variants approved
Automated smoke test pipeline added to staging and green for each cloud (logs stored in centralized dashboard)
Legal sign-off recorded in confluence and release ticket; security review checklist completed
Staged rollout plan published with explicit region schedule, rollback steps, and on-call rotation for each window
